messages:
Alex Chen: hey team — first day here. trying to enroll my new MacBook Pro (M2) into Kandji. Kandji console says "Awaiting device check-in" and on-device it just shows "Waiting for network" even though wifi is connected to corp-eap and web works. any quick tips?
Maria Patel: welcome @Alex! can you confirm macOS version and whether you saw any profile or cert prompts during the upgrade? sometimes the CA prompt gets hidden.
Alex Chen: on Ventura 13.6.1 (upgraded yesterday). i didn't notice any persistent profile in System Settings > Profiles — nothing visible there. when i logged into the sso page a cert prompt flashed for a second but disappeared.
Jordan Lee: hi @Alex — occasional weirdness with EAP+PEAP networks: networkd can complete wifi but the system keychain won't trust the auth CA until it's installed. try grabbing the corp CA from https://sso.redwood.com/ca.pem then double-click to add to the System keychain and set it to "Always Trust" for SSL. after that run: 

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

that forces the MDM enrollment check-in.
Alex Chen: ok downloading CA now and installing to System keychain... pasted a snippet from /var/log/install.log earlier: 
```
profile enrollment failed: network timeout
```
running the renew command now.
Alex Chen: it worked — output: "Enrollment profile fetched; MDM profile installed". Kandji console now shows device online. woo! :tada:
Kandji Bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created for "MDM enrollment network timeout on macOS upgrade" and assigned to eng-infra.
Maria Patel: great. if anyone else hits this, DM me or email help@redwood.com. small onboarding note: post-update SSO cert prompts can be easy to miss.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone — i'll add a short step to the onboarding doc so new hires know to check System keychain for the CA.
Jordan Lee: awesome, if you drop that in #docs-onboarding i'll make sure the infra runbook references it. :thumbsup:
